'''Grav slides''' were recreational items used by children. One [[Unidentified child (Branli)|child's]] [[Plasticene/Legends|plasticene]] [[Doll/Legends|doll]], [[Branli]], fell on the grav slide, resulting in a broken finger. The child's [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid]], [[Dooba]], fixed the doll.
